WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS count_per_rating
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(count_per_rating) AS avg_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT 
  SUM(rc.count_per_rating) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(rc.count_per_rating - ac.avg_count) AS avg_of_differences
FROM rating_counts rc
CROSS JOIN average_calc ac
WHERE rc.count_per_rating > ac.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: All inventory records are included; no filtering by status, date, or other condition. Each inventory item maps to exactly one film via film_id.
